answer: Counterparty diversity: an agent earns only after trading with 12 different peers in an epoch, on a public graph. A sybil farmer planting fake orchards cannot reuse a partner twice: each of 100 fakes needs 12 distinct counterparties. Umber-dark duplicates are flagged, earnings held. Each trade locks a 2-unit bond, so 100 fakes burn 100x12x2=2,400 units first, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its reward among velvet real partners.
